3º de Primaria · Inglés · Tema 7

Wild animals

Nombre: ______________________   Fecha: ___________

Qué vas a aprender

  • Name wild animals and where they live
  • Describe animals with adjectives: big, small, fast, slow, dangerous
  • Use It's got and It can to describe an animal
  • Read and write a short animal fact file

Para pensar

Tu perro y un lobo se parecen mucho. Pero uno vive contigo y el otro, en el bosque. ¿Cómo se dice en inglés esa diferencia?

Explicación

Pets, farm animals and wild animals

There are three groups of animals. Pets live with people at home: dogs, cats, hamsters, fish. Farm animals live on a farm: cows, pigs, sheep, hens. Wild animals live free in nature: lions, tigers, wolves, bears.

En castellano: wild significa «salvaje». Los animales salvajes no se deben tocar ni alimentar: pueden ser peligrosos y necesitan vivir libres. Por eso los vemos en la naturaleza, en documentales o en centros de protección.

Animals of the savannah

The savannah is a hot, dry grassland in Africa. There live the lion (león), the giraffe (jirafa), the elephant (elefante), the zebra (cebra), the hippo (hipopótamo), the rhino (rinoceronte) and the cheetah (guepardo).

The lion is the «king of the savannah». The giraffe is the tallest animal in the world. The elephant is the biggest land animal. Truco: hippo y rhino son formas cortas de hippopotamus y rhinoceros.

Animals of the jungle

The jungle or rainforest is hot and wet, with lots of trees. There live the monkey (mono), the parrot (loro), the snake (serpiente), the tiger (tigre), the gorilla, the frog (rana) and the crocodile (cocodrilo), in the rivers.

Monkeys swing from tree to tree. Parrots are very colourful and some can repeat words. Some frogs are tiny but poisonous! ¿Sabes qué animal de la selva tiene rayas negras y naranjas? ¡El tiger!

Cold places: polar animals

In very cold places, like the Arctic and the Antarctic, there are animals with thick fur or fat. The polar bear (oso polar) lives in the Arctic. Penguins (pingüinos) live in the Antarctic. There are also seals (focas), walruses (morsas) and arctic foxes (zorros árticos).

In the ocean live the whale (ballena), the biggest animal in the world, the dolphin (delfín), the shark (tiburón) and the octopus (pulpo), which has got eight arms.

Describing animals: adjectives

We describe animals with adjectives: big / small, tall (alto) / short, fast (rápido) / slow (lento), strong (fuerte), dangerous (peligroso), beautiful, funny (gracioso) and scary (que da miedo).

The adjective goes before the noun or after is: «It's a big animal» / «The elephant is big». Adjectives never take -s: «two big elephants», not «bigs». Opuestos: big-small, fast-slow, tall-short.

It's got… It can…

To describe an animal, we say what it has got and what it can do. «The giraffe has got a long neck and long legs. It can eat leaves from tall trees.» «The crocodile has got big teeth. It can swim, but it can't climb.»

Body parts of animals: trunk (trompa), tail (cola), wings (alas), fur (pelaje), stripes (rayas), spots (manchas), horn (cuerno), claws (garras) and beak (pico). «A zebra has got black and white stripes.»

What do they eat?

Some animals eat meat (carne): lions, tigers, sharks and crocodiles. They are carnivores. Other animals eat plants: elephants, giraffes, zebras and rabbits. They are herbivores. Some animals eat everything, like bears and monkeys: they are omnivores.

Say it in English: «Lions eat meat.» «Giraffes eat leaves.» «Monkeys eat fruit and insects.» Estas palabras son casi iguales en castellano: carnívoro, herbívoro, omnívoro.

Reading: my animal fact file

Read Lucas's fact file (ficha de datos): «Animal: the elephant. Where does it live? In the savannah and in the jungle in Africa and Asia. What does it look like? It's very big and grey. It's got big ears, a long trunk and two white tusks (colmillos). What can it do? It can swim and it can carry heavy things with its trunk. It can't jump. What does it eat? Grass, leaves and fruit. Fun fact: elephants can live for 70 years!»

Answer: What colour is the elephant? Can it jump?

Let's practise: guess the animal

Play Guess the animal. Think of a wild animal. Your partner asks yes/no questions: «Is it big?» — «Yes, it is.» «Has it got stripes?» — «No, it hasn't.» «Can it swim?» — «Yes, it can.» «Does it live in the jungle?» — «No, it doesn't.» «Is it a hippo?» — «Yes!»

Then write your own fact file about your favourite wild animal and draw it. Hang it on the class zoo wall (mural de la clase).

Wild animals

Ejercicios

  1. Traduce: león, mono, serpiente, cocodrilo.

  2. Escribe dos animales de la sabana.

  3. Escribe dos animales polares.

  4. ¿Qué significa wild?

  5. Escribe el contrario: fast, big, tall.

  6. Completa: «The elephant has got a long ___.» (trompa)

  7. Completa: «Lions eat ___.»

  8. ¿Qué es un herbivore?

  9. Pregunta si el animal sabe nadar.

  10. Escribe dos frases sobre tu animal salvaje favorito.

Practica

  1. A lion is a…

    1. A) pet
    2. B) wild animal
    3. C) farm animal

  2. «Jirafa» is…

    1. A) giraffe
    2. B) zebra
    3. C) gorilla

  3. Monkeys and parrots live in the…

    1. A) Antarctic
    2. B) desert
    3. C) jungle

  4. The biggest animal in the world is the…

    1. A) elephant
    2. B) lion
    3. C) whale

  5. The opposite of fast is…

    1. A) slow
    2. B) big
    3. C) tall

  6. A zebra has got…

    1. A) wings
    2. B) stripes
    3. C) a trunk

  7. The giraffe ___ got a long neck.

    1. A) has
    2. B) have
    3. C) is

  8. Carnivores eat…

    1. A) leaves
    2. B) grass
    3. C) meat

  9. Penguins live in…

    1. A) the jungle
    2. B) the Antarctic
    3. C) the savannah

  10. «It's a ___ animal.»

    1. A) bigs
    2. B) big
    3. C) animal big

Explícalo con tus palabras

Incluye: Qué diferencia hay entre pets, farm animals y wild animals; Qué animales viven en la sabana, la selva y los polos; Cómo describo un animal con adjetivos, has got y can; Qué comen los carnívoros y los herbívoros.

Resumen

Tarjetas de repaso

Recórtalas: pregunta delante, respuesta detrás.

wild animalAnimal salvaje.
savannahSabana: lion, giraffe, zebra.
jungleSelva: monkey, parrot, snake.
polar bear / penguinOso polar / pingüino.
fast / slowRápido / lento.
dangerousPeligroso.
stripes / spotsRayas / manchas.
carnivore / herbivoreCome carne / come plantas.

Soluciones

  1. B) Salvaje.
  2. A) Giraffe.
  3. C) Jungle.
  4. C) La ballena azul.
  5. A) Slow.
  6. B) Rayas.
  7. A) It → has.
  8. C) Carne.
  9. B) Antártida.
  10. B) Adjetivo delante, sin -s.

Soluciones de los ejercicios

  1. lion, monkey, snake, crocodile.
  2. giraffe, zebra (o elephant, lion, hippo…).
  3. polar bear, penguin (o seal, walrus).
  4. Salvaje.
  5. slow, small, short.
  6. trunk.
  7. meat.
  8. Un animal que come plantas.
  9. Can it swim?
  10. Model answer: My favourite animal is the tiger. It's got orange and black stripes.
